description: Professional subscriber, editorial, newsletter, event, renewal, payment, and audience-engagement emails for publishers and media platforms.
placeholder_format: Use double-brace variables, for example {{customer_name}}. Replace every placeholder before sending.

templates.name: Newsletter Subscription Welcome
templates.trigger: Immediately after a reader confirms a newsletter subscription
templates.subject: Welcome to the {{publication_name}} Newsletter
templates.body:
Dear {{subscriber_name}},

Thank you for subscribing to {{publication_name}}. You’ll receive our latest articles, editorial highlights, important updates, and selected stories directly in your inbox.

Explore our latest content: {{website_url}}

We appreciate having you as a reader.

Best regards,
Editorial Team
{{publication_name}}

templates.name: Subscription Confirmation
templates.trigger: After a paid or free subscription is activated
templates.subject: Your Subscription Is Confirmed

templates.name: Daily News Briefing
templates.trigger: At the reader’s selected daily briefing time
templates.subject: Your Daily Briefing – {{date}}

templates.name: Breaking News Alert
templates.trigger: When editors publish a verified breaking-news alert
templates.subject: Breaking News: {{headline}}

templates.name: Weekly Content Digest
templates.trigger: On the reader’s selected weekly digest schedule
templates.subject: Your Weekly Reading List – {{week}}

templates.name: New Article Publication
templates.trigger: When a new article is published and selected for subscriber distribution
templates.subject: New Article: {{article_title}}

templates.name: Subscription Renewal Reminder
templates.trigger: Before a subscription is due to renew
templates.subject: Your {{publication_name}} Subscription Renews Soon

templates.name: Subscription Payment Failure
templates.trigger: When a subscription payment cannot be processed
templates.subject: Payment Issue with Your Subscription

templates.name: Event Invitation
templates.trigger: When an eligible subscriber is invited to an event
templates.subject: You’re Invited: {{event_name}}

templates.name: Reader Feedback Request
templates.trigger: After a defined period of readership or following a reader interaction
templates.subject: Help Us Improve {{publication_name}}
templates.body:
Dear {{subscriber_name}},

Your feedback helps us create more relevant and valuable content. We would appreciate a few minutes of your time to share your experience with our publication.

Share your feedback: {{survey_url}}

Thank you for supporting our work.

Regards,
Audience Engagement Team
{{publication_name}}

templates.name: Subscription Cancellation Confirmation
templates.trigger: After a subscription cancellation is completed
templates.subject: Your Subscription Cancellation Is Confirmed

templates.name: Inactive Subscriber Re-engagement
templates.trigger: When a subscriber has not engaged for a defined period
templates.subject: There’s More to Discover at {{publication_name}}
templates.body:
Dear {{subscriber_name}},

We noticed you haven’t visited {{publication_name}} recently. Our editorial team continues to publish new stories, reports, and insights across a range of topics.

Catch up on our latest content: {{latest_content_url}}

You can manage your email preferences here: {{preferences_url}}.

Best regards,
Audience Engagement Team
{{publication_name}}
